evidence: The film thickness and resistivity were measured under a field emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM) using a four-point probe method. X-ray diffraction (XRD) using Cu K radiation of λ = 1.5405 Å was used to examine the crystal structure of the deposited films. The film composition and density were measured using Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) and 2.43 MeV He 2+ Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS).
